problem_statement: When the flash key-value store is wiped after it has used both of its swap areas, only one of the two swap areas is erased; the other keeps previously stored records. After such a wipe the device should fully erase both swap areas so no stale settings remain and the active swap marker is freshly written, leaving the store immediately usable without a new initialization.
